title: I made 100 games in less than 48 hours
author: ZeroFokksFuel
selftext:
I’ve been using Claude for a few years now but I’ve never been as impressed with any model like I have been with Opus 5.5, not since 4.6 at least.

I spent less than 2 days building Brainhive - a collection of 100 bite-sized games that are focused on memory, logic, speed etc. And each month the games get new content. I used Phaser as a game engine combined with React and TypeScript and Framer Motion for animations. The backend is Supabase, Cloudflare and Resend, hosted on Vercel. Vitest and Playwright for testing.

Happy to answer more in depth questions about the process.  
Feedback very welcome.

Play here 👉 [brainhive.games](https://www.brainhive.games)
